text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Animals and Birds (Fees) Rules 2009 and shall come into operation on 1st April 2009.

2. The fees specified in the Schedule may be charged by the Board in respect of the matters or services set out opposite thereto.
[S 215/2019 wef 01/04/2019]

2A. The Director‑General may waive or refund in whole or in part any fee payable or paid under these Rules in any particular case.
[S 131/2026 wef 31/03/2026]
3. The Animals and Birds (Quarantine) Rules (R 6) and the Animals and Birds (Veterinary Fees) Rules (R 8) are revoked.

THE SCHEDULE
Rule 2
Fees
1.Application for a licence to import, export or tranship animals for commercial purposes
$87 per consignment
1A.Expedited processing of an application in item 1
$87 per consignment, in addition to the fee in item 1
2.Application for a licence to import, export or tranship birds (including eggs) for commercial purposes
$62 per consignment
2A.Expedited processing of an application in item 2
$62 per consignment, in addition to the fee in item 2
3.Application for a licence to import, export or tranship animals or birds as personal effects
$50 per consignment
3A.Expedited processing of an application in item 3
$50 per consignment, in addition to the fee in item 3
4.Application for a licence to import or tranship veterinary biologics
$22 per consignment
4A.Expedited processing of an application in item 4
$22 per consignment, in addition to the fee in item 4
5.Application for a licence to export carcases
$22 per consignment
5A.Expedited processing of an application in item 5
$22 per consignment, in addition to the fee in item 5
6.Application for a permit to import or tranship carcases, semen, fodder, dung, products of animals or birds, or articles or substances that are likely to convey or spread disease
$22 per consignment
7.Application for a licence to treat, vaccinate or inoculate animals or birds
$80 per licence for 2 years or part thereof
8.Application for a licence to possess veterinary biologics
$45 per licence
9.Application for a restricted licence to inoculate animals or birds with veterinary biologics
$16 per licence for one year or part thereof
10.Evaluation of veterinary vaccines
$210 per veterinary vaccine
11.Certificate of freedom from disease within Singapore
$12.60 per certificate
12.Veterinary certificate
$23 per certificate
13.Certification of freedom from rabies
$37 per examination
14.Certified true copy of any licence, permit, certificate or other document issued by the Director-General under the Act or any of the rules made thereunder, or the endorsement or certification by the Director-General of any document used for the purposes of the Act
$9.45 per copy
15.Quarantine fees (per day or part of a day) at a quarantine station established and managed by the Director-General, for —
(a)cats or dogs (non-air conditioned, with feed)
$26 per animal
(b)cats or dogs (air conditioned, with feed)
$35 per animal
16.Inspection and vaccination of cats and dogs against rabies at a quarantine station mentioned in item 15
$68 per animal
17.Accommodation at Changi Animal and Plant Quarantine Unit for —
(a)cats or dogs (with feed)
$35 per animal for one day or part thereof
(b)other animals or birds (without feed)
$35 per kennel unit for one day or part thereof
18.Impoundment of —
(a)dogs
$93 per dog
(b)cats
$47 per cat
19.Professional service fee —
(a)in the case where the service is required outside office hours or on an urgent basis
$133 per hour or part thereof
(b)in any other case
$63 per hour or part thereof
20.Technical service fee —
(a)in the case where the service is required outside office hours or on an urgent basis
$80 per hour or part thereof
(b)in any other case
$38 per hour or part thereof.
[S 131/2026 wef 31/03/2026]
